data.reasoning: The package consists of a standard PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO. The source is fetched from the official upstream GitHub repository with a pinned version and a valid SHA256 checksum. The build and package functions perform standard make operations. There is no evidence of injected malicious code, arbitrary command execution, or suspicious network activity.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when reviewing the PKGBUILD, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict, while the deepseek model successfully reviewed the file and correctly marked it as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts and escalation triggers.
When a full file review fails but an initial pre-flight check succeeds, consider falling back to the pre-flight assessment rather than failing the entire audit.
